name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that jumps straight to the main content, so users with screen readers or keyboards can bypass navigation. This decision prioritizes efficiency for users who rely on assistive technologies, and the trade-off is a slightly cluttered top-of-page design for mouse users. By placing the skip link at the top, we ensure it's the first thing screen readers announce, making it easily accessible. The high contrast will also make it visible to low-vision users, even if they have custom browser settings.

name: Reader
text: A persistent skip link risks hiding the main content behind a moving target when the page loads, making it unreliable for screen-reader users who tab through everything. Instead, use a skip link that only appears after the page finishes loading, ensuring it doesn’t interfere with initial navigation. Test this with a screen reader and keyboard to confirm it doesn’t shift focus unexpectedly.
